summary: Volition's Mars-set shooter series built around Geo-Mod destruction, including the open-world Guerrilla and its later Re-Mars-tered edition.

primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively or through a modern PC storefront where available; use PS4 only as a convenient console re-release route and PS2/N-Gage/mobile for preservation comparison.

entries.title: Red Faction: Guerrilla

primary.why: Guerrilla released on PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Windows in 2009, then as Re-Mars-tered on Windows, PS4, Xbox One, and Switch. Re-Mars-tered includes the original DLC and technical improvements, and Windows is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Red Faction: Guerrilla Re-Mars-tered on Windows at the highest stable settings; use PS4 Pro/Xbox One X for strong 4K/60fps-capable console routes or Switch for portable play.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC release plus 2018 Re-Mars-tered PC remaster with technical improvements and included DLC.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most complete route.
